question: What is the average overall rating of the players born before the year 1986?
evidence: average overall rating = DIVIDE(SUM(overall_rating), COUNT(id)); born before the year 1986 refers to strftime('%Y', birthday) < '1986';
clarification: Count each distinct id only once.
gold: SELECT SUM(t2.overall_rating) / COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTRING(t1.birthday, 1, 4) < '1986'
gold0: SELECT SUM(t2.overall_rating) / COUNT(t1.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(t1.birthday, 1, 4) < '1986'

c.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(r.overall_rating) / COUNT(r.id) AS average_overall_rating FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pa.id, pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986') AS r;

b.request: What is the sum of overall ratings for players born before 1986, divided by the count of distinct Player_Attributes IDs for those players?
b.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(pa.overall_rating) / COUNT(DISTINCT pa.id) AS result FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.birthday < '1986-01-01';

d.request: What is the average overall rating of players born before 1986, counting each distinct player ID only once?
d.sql: SELECT AVG(player_rating) FROM (SELECT pa.player_api_id, AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS player_rating FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.birthday < '1986-01-01' GROUP BY pa.player_api_id)
